content:
molly.ops: heads up — scheduling a short maintenance window for fleet heartbeat service tomorrow 02:00-03:00 UTC. this will trigger rolling control-plane restarts and soft reboots across pools. low risk but needs coordination. :wave:

jason_oncall: thanks. which regions/pools are in scope? any tenant affinity impacted?
aisha_sre: primary targets: eu-west*, us-west1 edge pools, and one small batch in apac for validation. tenant affinity preserved, but we'll be cordoning nodes and doing graceful drain. expect ~3-6% capacity hit in eu-west peak of the window.
molly.ops: exact pools: saturn, comet, and a 50-node slice of orion-edge. we'll do cohorted codenames to avoid blast radius. canaries first in eu-west1 then us-west1 then apac.
ranjit_eng: what's the fallback if warm-kv cache seeding fails and latency spikes? need an automatic rollback path.
aisha_sre: plan: 1) canary with synthetic traffic and p95 check 2) if p95 > 200ms for >2min, rollback control-plane to previous image and abort further cohorts 3) route traffic to dedicated pool as fallback (manual trigger by oncall).
release-bot: deploy starting: 7998885600, canary window: 10m, cohort interval: 12m. automated healthchecks enabled.
jason_oncall: ok i'll be on standby for the rollback trigger. i'll also wire a runbook note in the incident channel.
taylor_cs: heads up for CS — estimated customer impact: minor transient 5-10s tail for a small subset. will prepare canned messages if we need to notify paying customers.
molly.ops: cost note: we may temporarily spin up burst capacity if backfills lag. that could add ~$120/hr worst-case for the window. prefer to accept cost vs risk. thoughts?
ranjit_eng: fine for 1hr blast if it reduces SLA risk. confirm autoscaler max override enabled?
aisha_sre: autoscaler max override ON for the window, but we'll cap burst to one additional node group. ops will monitor.
jason_oncall: I'll update the routing policy to reduce long-running jobs landing on cohorts during the window. quick script i run: `./scripts/evac-cohort.sh --cohort saturn --start`
molly.ops: perfect. communication checklist: - customer advisory draft (taylor) - oncall watch (jason) - rollback flag + alert thresholds (aisha) - cost approval (ranjit) - deploybot scheduled (release-bot)
taylor_cs: draft ready, will push to #customer-comm if we escalate.
molly.ops: sweet. starting preflight checks now, posting final go/no-go 01:30 UTC. ping me if you see anything odd. :thumbsup:
